description: MusicVerse curated links organized by instrument; accordion resources and restored Accordion Music spreadsheet listening references. Personal saves remain in existing MusicVerse user references.
sources: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog: Accordion Music tab

resources.title: Amélie accordion scores: collection
resources.notes: Collection includes La Valse d’Amélie, La Noyée, and L’autre valse d’Amélie. Verify uploader permission before downloading.

resources.title: La Valse d’Amélie: accordion arrangements
resources.notes: Several accordion versions, including Carla Steiner's arrangement; compare left-hand writing for your piano accordion.

resources.title: La Noyée: accordion score options
resources.notes: Different chromatic and diatonic arrangements are listed. Choose a piano-accordion-compatible score.

resources.title: L’autre valse d’Amélie: accordion score
resources.notes: Listed in the Amélie score collection; link opens the collection where you can locate this specific arrangement.

resources.title: La Valse d’Amélie: licensed solo accordion PDF
resources.notes: Julia Gordon arrangement, solo accordion. Listed at $7.69 when researched; check price and licensing at purchase.

resources.title: Valse d’Amélie: accordion arrangement with video
resources.notes: Accordion-specific arrangement with a score preview and demonstration; full PDF requires site access.

resources.title: Comptine d’un autre été: accordion arrangements
resources.notes: Browse listings and choose the accordion instrumental-solo version, not the more common piano solo score.

resources.title: Video to identify and find sheet music for
resources.notes: Requested exact performance; title and composer not independently confirmed. Do not substitute a guessed song title.

resources.title: 120-bass Stradella button chart
resources.notes: Labels root bass, counterbass, major, minor, seventh and diminished chords. On 96-bass accordions the same system has fewer columns.

resources.title: Stradella bass system: layout and chords
resources.notes: General visual overview of standard bass rows and the circle-of-fifths arrangement.

resources.title: Free accordion fingering chart PDF
resources.notes: Beginner-facing downloadable accordion fingering and bass layout chart.

resources.title: Accordion-scores.com score library
resources.notes: Searchable collection of accordion arrangements, including many French songs and film music.

resources.title: EasyAccordion: arrangements and demonstrations
resources.notes: Accordion-specific arrangements with preview videos; full access may require payment.

resources.title: La Valse d’Amélie: Kateryna Sushko performance
resources.notes: Accordion performance of the film theme; artist points to sheet music in video description.

resources.title: History and cultural role of the accordion
resources.notes: Background reading about accordion development and use across traditions.

resources.title: Säkkijärven polkka
resources.notes: Classic Finnish accordion polka; essential reference for rhythmic drive and bellows articulation.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: (Weekend Au) Balajo
resources.notes: Paris bal-musette sound: waltz phrasing, ornamentation, and the characteristic musette shimmer.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Line Redpath Waltz
resources.notes: Classic Scottish dance-band accordion approach; crisp phrasing and dance rhythm.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Teche Special
resources.notes: Old-school Cajun accordion; a strong example of the punchy diatonic style and vocal-like phrasing.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: I'm Coming Home (To See My Mother)
resources.notes: Creole/zydeco accordion tradition; blues and R&B-inflected groove.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Ay Te Dejo en San Antonio
resources.notes: Signature conjunto accordion language: rhythmic, melodic, and highly conversational.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Libertango
resources.notes: Bandoneón rather than piano accordion, but indispensable for hearing the expressive free-reed family outside folk dance music.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Asa Branca
resources.notes: Foundational Brazilian accordion repertoire; syncopated baião rhythm and singing melodic lines.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: La Gota Fria
resources.notes: Accordion is central to vallenato; lively melodic fills and rhythmic interplay with percussion.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Die Dorfschöne
resources.notes: A defining Alpine/Slovenian polka sound, with accordion at the center of the ensemble texture.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Summertime (Arr. for Accordion by Richard Galliano)
resources.notes: Shows how naturally accordion handles jazz harmony, rubato, phrasing, and standards.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Classic Russian Accordion Bayan
resources.notes: A Spotify playlist rather than one track; useful survey of the chromatic-button bayan tradition.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Folk Accordéon Québécois
resources.notes: A Spotify survey playlist for French-Canadian dance tunes and accordion accompaniment styles.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Balkan Accordion Vibes
resources.notes: Survey playlist highlighting fast ornamentation, odd meters, and virtuosic Balkan accordion playing.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Celtic traditional - TP Mix
resources.notes: Survey playlist for Irish/Celtic traditional playing; useful for hearing button-accordion repertoire alongside the broader tradition.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Folk Italiano Tarantella
resources.notes: Survey playlist for Italian accordion dance traditions, especially tarantella repertoire.

resources.title: Señor Locutor
resources.notes: Norteño accordion in a modern regional-Mexican ensemble context.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Klezmer Accordion Vibes

resources.title: Accordion Rock by They Might Be Giants
resources.artist: Various / They Might Be Giants focus
resources.notes: Survey playlist showing accordion used as a rock/alternative texture rather than strictly folk instrumentation.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Accordion Rock The Decemberists
resources.notes: Indie-rock context for accordion, useful for hearing how the instrument sits with guitars, drums, and narrative songwriting.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Accordion Tracks By Weird Al
resources.notes: A deliberately nontraditional lane: accordion used in pop parody and rock arrangements.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Flor de Dalia
resources.notes: A second conjunto reference, closer to the stripped-down traditional accordion-and-rhythm approach.
resources.source: Crazy Rock Covers Catalog / Accordion Music

resources.title: Feira de Mangaio

resources.title: Payotte

resources.title: Amoureusement

resources.title: Margaret Mackinnon of Digg

resources.title: Jacksons' No. 2 / Jean's Reel / The Moving Cloud

resources.title: Gone With the Wind

resources.title: Musette Swing (French Accordion)

resources.title: Tony Murena
resources.notes: Artist reference for one of the important musette-jazz accordion voices.

resources.title: Cape Verde Funana Accordion Vibes
resources.notes: Funaná uses diatonic accordion in fast, propulsive dance music with a very different rhythmic feel.

resources.notes: Survey of Ukrainian folk repertoire on accordion.
